selectedCompleteRows.text: | [Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes](/wiki/education/concepts/immunology/tumor-immunology/tumor-infiltrating-lymphocytes) | A fictional tissue schematic excludes malignant nests from eligible stroma, then pools five equal stromal-area units containing one occupied unit to show 20 percent stromal-area infiltration. This is an area estimate, not a cell count. | `stromal-area-and-pooled-region-weighting-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [H&E morphology: reading cells in their tissue setting](/wiki/education/concepts/measurement/pathology-readouts/h-and-e-morphology) | A fictional tissue block yields one selected section showing a cell cluster and surrounding matrix, with blue-purple nuclei and pink broad tissue staining rather than a named molecule count. | `h-and-e-section-shapes-and-setting-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [Immunohistochemistry: protein staining in tissue](/wiki/education/concepts/measurement/pathology-readouts/immunohistochemistry) | One hundred invented eligible cells are represented by 100 circles grouped by staining intensity: 50 unstained, 10 weak, 20 moderate and 20 strong. The same 100-cell denominator gives 50% positive cells, whereas intensity weights one, two and three give H-score 10 plus 40 plus 60 equals 110. Category rows are an explanatory grouping, not tissue geography. Allred is a separate categorical system. Neither quantity is a molecule count, a universal clinical cutoff or an interchangeable assay output. | `ihc-intensity-distribution-and-positive-fraction-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [PD-L1 scoring: CPS, TPS and IC score](/wiki/education/concepts/measurement/pathology-readouts/pd-l1-scoring) | Grouped fictional inventories show 200 viable tumor cells with 20 staining, 40 eligible stained lymphocytes and 20 eligible stained macrophages, yielding CPS 40 and tumor-cell percentage 10%. | `pd-l1-eligible-cells-and-tumor-denominator-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |

| [Stromal TIL scoring: what the percentage counts](/wiki/education/concepts/measurement/pathology-readouts/stil-scoring) | A schematic pretend pretreatment section distinguishes excluded malignant nests and eligible stroma inside invasive-tumor borders. Separate invented area blocks show region A with four equal units of eligible stroma and 0.4 units occupied by infiltrate, and B with one equal unit of stroma and 0.6 occupied units. At the same scale, the pooled-area fraction is 1/5, or 20%; the unweighted regional mean is 35%. Area, not cell count, is the denominator. This toy geometry is not a mandated pixel workflow; pretreatment and residual-bed methods remain distinct. | `stromal-area-and-pooled-region-weighting-v1-light.svg` | Present | Present |
